items.title: reasoning-firebreak law should be durable when a shipped revision relies on a tiny public extract
items.judged_property: the admitted rev0105 change should be reconstructible from a compact public extract without inheriting local comparison notes or scratchpad-like drafting residue as canon evidence
items.public_extract: Operationalize existing reasoning-firebreak law with one compact public-extract witness and one durable firebreak ledger entry so the revision states what counts publicly and what larger trace surface stays withheld.
items.allowed_role: monitoring and bounded later challenge only; not canon evidence, not ordinary reentry state, and not citation surface
items.exposure_rule: Only thicken the public extract or temporarily expose a narrower trace slice if a later pass shows the shipped extract is insufficient to reconstruct the judged property honestly.
